errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. The sequence is Südkorea, Japan, Schweden, etc. The categories are arranged based on the descending value of the bars.

The bar for Dänemark (Denmark) is at approximately 6.5%, not 8%. It is visibly lower than the bar for Vereinigtes Königreich (United Kingdom), which is at approximately 8.5% but is also described as 'etwa 8%'.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert, außer der alphabetischen Anordnung der Länder auf der horizontalen Achse.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in two ways. First, the bars are sorted in a specific order (descending by value). Second, the labels on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order. The statement is also self-contradictory.
